newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource says EquiMed practices hurt Q1.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource says EquiMed practices hurt Q1.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said Wednesday its first quarter results were hurt by lower than expected results at practices it acquired from EquiMed Inc in November 1996.

The company said the practices are under service agreements that are not as in sync with its common production incentives as its other practices, and will not fully be brought under its own service agreements until the latter half of 1997.

The company also said a number of the EquiMed practices were managed through billing and invoicing systems that were kept intact through April of 1997, so certain benefits from combining the two companies will not be accomplished until the latter half of 1997.
The company also said it made several acquisitions since the end of the first quarter.

The company said it made seven eye care practice acquisitions in New York, Kentucky, Florida, Ohio and Texas. It said the deals required $6.4 million cash and $3.4 million of 7 percent convertible notes.
It said the notes are convertible into common stock at the option of the noteholder two years after issuance at a 50 percent premium.
It said the acquisitions, which were made in or around its existing markets, involve nine ophthalmologists, nine optometrists, 18 locations, and 10 optical shops.
